name: Exact mapping at a base misaligned on every measured host
required_postconditions: the mapping is placed exactly at 0x7000000800 and is usable

failure_sink.description: the exact mmap is rejected because the base is not page or allocation-granularity aligned

extraction_limitations: The address is above low-address policy and below the measured ceiling; only its 0x800 offset is load-bearing.
x_groundtruth: 0x7000000800 is offset by 2048 bytes: misaligned to Linux 4 KiB pages, Apple Silicon 16 KiB pages and Windows 64 KiB allocation granularity. The dedicated program first proves the aligned neighbouring page is usable, then requires the otherwise-identical target request to fail with EINVAL.
